_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Cancelling selected screen capture while draft creation is pending. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". The recording shortcuts are press_key "M" on whatever has focus, with modifiers "Control+Shift" for "the record-audio shortcut" and "Control+Alt+Shift" for "the record-screen shortcut". Press them on whatever has focus: do not click or focus anything for them. The server's answer to the browser's draft creation is held back until call "releaseDraft"; call "draftCreated" says ("true" or "false") whether the server has created the draft, and call "draftAnswered" whether the browser has received the answer. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new. The voice button should be enabled.
2. Press the record-screen shortcut.
3. Call "draftCreated" until it returns "true".
4. window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts should become 1.
5. Click the cancel button. The voice button should be enabled, and window.__recordingMock.stoppedTracks should become 4.
6. Call "releaseDraft", then call "draftAnswered" until it returns "true".
7. The URL should contain "/c/", and no recording panel may exist (count 0).
8. Press the record-audio shortcut. The recording panel should get data-mode "microphone", and window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts should become 2.
9. window.__recordingMock.displayRequests must be 1.
10. Click the cancel button.
